featured.title: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
featured.tldr: LingBot-Touch learns one touch representation across three kinds of tactile sensors from 5,000 hours of data, and its small frozen encoder raises real-robot success by 14 to 26 points.

featured.title: On Agentic Manipulation Policies
featured.tldr: Letting a general-purpose AI model write code that directly drives a robot arm, with no demonstrations or robot-specific training, beats leading specialist vision-language-action policies by a wide margin.

featured.title: RynnVLA-Latent: Scaling Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models with 3D-Grounded Latent Actions
featured.tldr: Alibaba's RynnVLA-Latent pretrains a robot policy on 30,100 hours of human, robot and simulation video using 3D-grounded latent actions, then adapts it to real robots, matching or edging out leading policies.

featured.title: DiscoDemo: Discovering Efficient and Diverse Robot Demonstrations for Imitation Learning
featured.tldr: Training a simulated RL "demonstrator" to find many different successful solutions, rather than one, doubles the real-robot success of a vision-language-action policy trained on its demos.

featured.title: Rethinking World-Action Model for Compositional and In-Context Robotic Manipulation
featured.tldr: ViGAR splits robot manipulation into a planner that imagines the next subgoal as an image and a world-action model that executes it, reaching 82.00% and 67.02% on RoboTwin Clean2Random, 12.86 points above the best baseline.

featured.title: PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
featured.tldr: PointWAM forecasts how a scene and the robot's hands move as 3D point trajectories, letting it pre-train on 1.15 million human videos and then beat strong vision-language-action models on dexterous manipulation.
